card.name: Marxism and Soviet history text
card.fires_on: Ordinary small words and punctuation (commas, 'of', 'the', 'at', 'my') inside web passages about Marxism, Russian communism, Stalin, Lenin or Hitler's ideology. It is the political-history setting that matters, not the word.

modes.label: Soviet and Marxist passages
modes.description: Small linking words or commas inside text about Soviet institutions, Stalin, Lenin or Marxist thinkers.
modes.example: adopted on 29 April 1918 by resolution of the All Russian Central Committee of Worker<<,>> Soldier, Peasant, and Coss

modes.label: Hitler and Marxism quotes
modes.description: Small words inside quotations or descriptions of Hitler's views on Marxism and Bolshevism.
